text:
Sounds and perfumes, Claude Achilles,
turn in the air of the lovely night.
You know where a rose-note goes astray,
a rare fragrance of muted bugles,


subdued, of subtle castanets
and moonlight of guitars. Your lazy
orchestra, butterfly by butterfly,
opens ninety music stands to you.


Iberia, Andalusia, Spain in dreams,
slow Granadas, fragile Sevilles,
Giralda towers, three by eight, high Comares.


And metals in bloom, celestial woods
raise to cheek level
tears of carnations and orange blossoms.

translation.title: To C. A. Debussy
